name: Gastric Juice (Grat)
doc: Gastric Juice (Grat's attack): the root and the director - the five juice streams with their blobs, mesh, drips and puddle, the splash, the tinted target, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag169_gastric_juice.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and mesh buffers in the module, its packets in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The five juice streams with their blobs, mesh, drips and puddle, the splash, the tinted target, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the director

params.label: Blob
params.doc: The sprite sequence blob (a flipbook of 8 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Drip
params.doc: The sprite sequence drip (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Splash
params.doc: The sprite sequence splash (a flipbook of 9 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Main model
params.doc: The prim model main (a mesh of 73 vertices, 72 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Puddle model
params.doc: The prim model puddle (a mesh of 72 vertices, 48 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
